text: The Civic Appointments Committee must select candidates to be interviewed for appointment to the Toronto Parking Authority Board. The Civic Appointments Committee will conduct interviews at its July 8, 2021 meeting and recommend two candidates for appointment to City Council.

The Civic Appointments Committee: 1. Selected the following candidates for interview at its next meeting for appointment to the Toronto Parking Authority Board: TPA2-84 TPA2-92 TPA2-100 TPA2-101 TPA2-108 TPA2-122 2. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1 and 2 to the report (May 30, 2021) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Toronto Parking Authority Board.
